summary: Perplexity for Startups gives eligible startups $5,000 in Sonar API credits plus 3 months of free Perplexity Enterprise Pro for up to 50 seats. Eligibility: raised up to $20M in equity funding, less than 5 years old, and associated with an approved Startup Partner; existing Enterprise Pro customers are not eligible. (Program page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch; terms corroborated from the official page's own copy via search index.)
claim_steps: Confirm eligibility: <5 years old, ≤$20M raised, linked to an approved Perplexity Startup Partner, not an existing Enterprise Pro subscriber.
Apply via perplexity.ai/startups or through your Startup Partner.
On approval, activate Enterprise Pro seats and redeem the $5,000 API credits.

social_proof.text: Eligible startups get 3 months of free Perplexity Enterprise Pro for up to 50 seats, plus $5k in API credits to supercharge their growth. Any startup that has raised up to $20M in equity funding, is less than 5 years old, and is associated with one of our Startup Partners.
